links.comparator_used: Same vaping ads presented with no source label, or with other labels (made by WHO, made with AI by WHO), compared across four between-participant labeling conditions
links.outcome: Perceived message effectiveness (vaping perception, behavioral intent, attention, information, convincingness) of vaping awareness ads
links.effect: Labeling conditions did not differ significantly on PME scores; χ2 values ranged from 0.10 to 4.19, all P > .20
links.quote: Source labeling showed no significant association with PME scores (χ2 values ranging from 0.10 to 4.19; all P > .20).
